name: Routr
what_it_is: Routr is a cloud-native SIP proxy, location server, and registrar targeting telephony carriers, communication service providers, and integrators. It provides programmable routing, multi-tenant/multi-domain architecture, and load balancing against media servers such as Asterisk and FreeSWITCH.
components: Middleware framework (cross-cutting concerns: auth, rate limiting)
measurement: No built-in metrics/observability tooling documented in README
Health state inferred via gRPC API server status
configuration: SSH port forwarding for remote access
fault_injection: No explicit fault injection framework documented
modes: Session affinity mode for media server load balancing
constraints: Region-based routing is not yet implemented
STIR/SHAKEN support is not yet implemented
Web application UI is not yet implemented
Location service in-memory backend does not persist across restarts (Redis required for persistence)
docker-compose.yml not present on main or master branch (no canonical single-file local stack definition found)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found on main or master branch
